name: Quietus Games
source:
Yasmine and Sylvia have been pro TCG rivals for the past ten years. As a birthday surprise, Sylvia invites Yasmine to play something a little different at a theme park that seems to only exist in urban legends. Now they're trapped in life-or-death games they must win to find the secret at the top of the park's castle.

[From [url=https://heptad.itch.io/quietus-games]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在过去的十年里，Yasmine和Sylvia一直是TCG职业选手的竞争对手。作为生日惊喜，西尔维娅邀请亚斯明在一个似乎只存在于都市传说中的主题公园玩一些有点不同的东西。现在，他们陷入了生死攸关的游戏，他们必须获胜才能找到公园城堡顶部的秘密。

[来自[url=https://heptad.itch.io/quietus-games]itch.io[/url]]
